2610.10407.title: SOTA: Stock Options Trading Agents Guided by Option-Implied Return Distributions
2610.10407.paper_summary: As option markets grow and AI advances, agentic systems for option trading are gaining increasing attention. Language-model-based agents can reason over contextual information such as news, but option trading presents a particularly challenging decision problem: a single stock can have thousands of contracts, and the agent must decide both which contracts to trade and how to combine them. Existing approaches often sidestep this complexity by restricting the policy to a fixed strategy structure, such as a straddle, limiting their ability to switch strategies as market conditions change. We present SOTA (Stock Options Trading Agents), an agentic trading framework for structured option-strategy selection. SOTA abstracts the large option universe into strategy-level decisions while deterministic resolvers handle portfolio implementation. We develop SOTA by post-training Qwen3.8-27B with supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning. SOTA is evaluated on options on nine large-cap U.S. equities and SPY against rule-based and machine-learning strategy selectors in the same trading environment. Over a six-month out-of-sample period, SOTA earns an 18.3% total return with a Sharpe ratio of 1.60 and a maximum drawdown of 8.96%. We also document an asymmetric role of news: news improves frontier-teacher trajectories, but retaining news during reinforcement learning reduces out-of-sample return from 18.3% to -2.7%.
2610.10407.paper_summary_zh: 隨著選擇市場的增長和人工智慧的進步，選擇交易的代理系統正受到越來越多的關注。基於語言模型的代理可以推理新聞等上下文信息，但選擇交易呈現出一個特別具挑戰性的決策問題：單一股票可以有成千上萬的合約，而代理必須決定交易哪些合約以及如何組合它們。現有的方法通常通過將政策限制為固定的策略結構（如跨式交易）來迴避這種複雜性，這限制了它們在市場條件變化時切換策略的能力。我們提出了SOTA（股票選擇交易代理），這是一個結構化選擇策略的代理交易框架。SOTA將龐大的選擇宇宙抽象為策略層級的決策，而確定性解析器則負責投資組合的實施。我們通過對Qwen3.8-27B進行監督微調後再進行強化學習來開發SOTA。SOTA在九個大型美國股票和SPY的選擇上進行評估，並與同一交易環境中的基於規則和機器學習的策略選擇器進行比較。在六個月的樣本外期間，SOTA獲得了18.3%的總回報，夏普比率為1.60，最大回撤為8.96%。我們還記錄了新聞的非對稱作用：新聞改善了前沿教師的軌跡，但在強化學習過程中保留新聞會將樣本外回報從18.3%降低至-2.7%。
